First Yoruba pass. 20 -> 52 records. THE INVERSION AGAIN: Oshosi, the hunter orisha, was in the registry only as santeria_ochosi -- the diaspora form present and the Yoruba original absent, which is the third instance of this pattern in the programme after Nanaya/sogdian_nana and Lotan/yahwism_leviathan, and is flagged as a class of defect rather than three coincidences. Households were missing members: Oba (senior wife of Shango) in a registry holding Shango, Oya and Oshun; Yemowo in a registry holding Obatala; Aje in a registry holding her parent Olokun. THE OYO LINE: the registry held Shango, Aganju and Ajaka and then nothing -- no Orompoto (first female Alaafin, expelled the Nupe in 1555, founded the cavalry), no Ojigi (brought Dahomey to tribute in 1730), none of the eight eighteenth-century Alaafins destroyed by their own council, no Bashorun Gaa who destroyed four of them, no Abiodun, Aole, Afonja, Oluewu or Atiba, and no Moremi in a registry holding her husband Oranmiyan. 19 of the 32 additions are people rather than gods, and together they make the Oyo constitutional crisis expressible for the first time: the Oyo Mesi's parrot's egg, the Are Ona Kakanfo created by Ajagbo as its counterweight, and both instruments destroying what they were built to protect. 32 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/yoruba-expansion.txt. First Maya pass. 26 -> 90 records. A 79-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 9 hits and 70 absences, and several of the 9 are alias matches rather than holdings (Kisin resolves to maya_ah_puch, Ah Mun to maya_yum_kaax, Chac Chel to maya_ix_chel, God D to maya_itzamna). TWO DISTINCT GAPS. POPOL VUH: the corpus held the principals and almost nobody else in the book -- absent were Hun Batz and Hun Chouen, the elder half-brothers turned into monkeys who are the patron gods of every Maya scribe; their mother Xbaquiyalo; NINE OF THE TWELVE LORDS OF XIBALBA (it held the two supreme lords and exactly one of the ten subordinates, so the paired disease-offices were invisible); Avilix and Hacavitz, without whom Tohil is one god rather than the three that constitute the K'iche' lineage settlement; ALL FOUR of the men made of maize and ALL FOUR of their wives, who are what the book exists to explain; Xulu and Pacam, the seers through whom the Hero Twins arrange their own resurrection; and three of the four destroyers of the wooden people. CLASSIC PERIOD: not one Maya ruler was in the registry -- zero, in a corpus carrying Egyptian pharaohs, Mesopotamian kings, ten Mixtec lords and the whole Mexica tlatoani line. Nor were the gods the Classic inscriptions name: K'awiil (absent from a corpus about to hold SIX kings named after him -- the Ninurta/Ashur pattern again), God L, Pauahtun and the four Bacabs, GI and GIII of the Palenque Triad, Xaman Ek, Buluc Chabtan. 64 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/maya-expansion.txt: 27 Popol Vuh, 11 Classic gods, 23 rulers from six cities, 3 postclassic and colonial. ZERO pre-existing records mutated. The 23 rulers were chosen so the politics reads rather than samples: Tikal against Calakmul with both sides present (the 378 entrada, Stela 31, the Kaanul hegemony under Yuknoom the Great, Jasaw's reversal in 695); Palenque, where a succession through a woman produced the Cross Group theology; Copan and Quirigua, where in 738 a client beheaded the overlord who had installed him; Yaxchilan's Lintels 24 and 25; and El Peru-Waka', where Lady K'abel held kaloomte' and her husband did not. Three of the 23 are women who ruled or outranked. TRADITION-KEY PROBLEM, OBSERVED AND NOT TOUCHED: ALL TWELVE K'iche' records duplicate Maya records of the same Popol Vuh figures, and SEVEN of the twelve Yucatec Maya records duplicate Maya records -- nineteen figures held twice across three keys. Flagged as 11 CROSS-TRADITION rows, not merged; this is the third tradition in the programme needing that note (after Danel/Paghat and Olokun/Eshu), which argues for a deliberate tradition-key review rather than more case-by-case flags. TWO DELIBERATE NON-ADDITIONS: the Tonsured Maize God is identified by the treatments with Hun Hunahpu, already present, and Chac Chel is already an alias on maya_ix_chel; both are ALIAS rows rather than the duplicate this programme forbids. LETTER-LABEL RULE: where a Schellhas or Palenque label has been resolved to a name the name is primary and the label an alias (K'awiil/God K/GII, Pauahtun/God N); where it has not -- God L, GI, GIII -- the label IS the record's name, because inventing a reading would be worse. FOUR CONTRADICTIONS CARRIED: GII's Palenque birth date (28 vs 6 November 2360 BC); Tecun Uman's death (12 vs 20 February 1524); Itzamnaaj Bahlam's numbering at Yaxchilan (II vs III); Kan Ek's death (execution vs disease). 10 REJECT are collectives and offices (the four hundred boys, the Xibalbans, the Bacabs as a class, the four Chaacs, Ah Kin, Halach Uinic, Nacom, the wayob) -- the four named Bacabs are ingested individually and the class is not. 25 BLOCKED in three kinds: list-only deities (Acat, Kinich Kakmo, Ah Peku, Ah Tabai, Ah Kin Xoc, Ix Chup) under the same caution the Aztec pass applied to the Mexica lists; ambiguous referents (Ix Chebel Yax may or may not be Ix Chel; Itzam Cab Ain may or may not be Itzamna; Nim Ac and Nima Tziis may be epithets of two records already held); and named-but-empty figures who appear in this batch's own records as somebody's parent or antagonist with nothing else retrievable -- Spearthrower Owl is the one worth escalating, as he is the Teotihuacan figure behind the 378 entrada and may belong to a Teotihuacan lane. Two further blocks are scoping: the remaining Tikal and Copan king-lists, and the 1847 Caste War leaders. 10 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-10/maya-census.tsv and maya-audit.md.

First Chinese pass. 48 -> 98 records. A 72-name check across the WHOLE registry returned TWO hits and BOTH ARE FALSE -- 'Yanluo Wang' matched buddhist_yama and hindu_yama, figures at the other end of a transmission rather than the Chinese magistrate, and 'Tudigong' matched baule_asie, an unrelated West African earth deity, on a normalised alias. Seventy absences out of seventy-two, the worst hit rate this programme has recorded, in the religious corpus with more adherents and more surviving text than any other in the registry. ABSENT: all three of the Three Pure Ones, who are the highest deities in Daoism, in a corpus holding the Jade Emperor who is below them; SIX OF THE EIGHT IMMORTALS (the registry held Lu Dongbin and He Xiangu, and the Eight are a set that is painted, carved and invoked together); the ENTIRE underworld -- no Yanluo Wang, no Meng Po whose soup of forgetting every Chinese soul drinks, no Zhong Kui, no Ox-Head and Horse-Face, no Black and White Impermanence; the casts of BOTH novels the popular pantheon comes from (Sun Wukong without the pilgrimage, and Li Jing/Nezha/Jinzha/Muzha of the Fengshen Yanyi without Jiang Ziya, who holds the roster by which every god in that book is appointed); Chiyou, Xingtian, Kuafu and Jingwei, the four most-quoted figures in early Chinese myth after the sovereigns the registry did hold; the Four Perils; and Guan Yu and Mazu, who between them have more temples than any other two figures in the Chinese world. 50 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/chinese-expansion.txt. ZERO pre-existing records mutated. PATTERNS REPEATED FROM EARLIER LANES: the famous name without the thing it is defined against, now for the fifth tradition -- Huangdi without Chiyou, Houyi without Xihe whose suns he shot, Shennong without Jingwei his daughter, Guanyin without Red Boy whom she took, Chang'e without Zhu Bajie who was banished for propositioning her; and the group held as a fraction -- two of eight Immortals, three of five Four-Clans culture heroes, one of four Dragon Kings, one of ten Kings of Hell. TWO SCOPING DECISIONS: Chenghuang the City God and Tudigong the Earth God are REJECTED as classes, because the reference treatments define them as the tutelary deity of a particular town or field, multiplied indefinitely -- the same rule that turned away the Ajogun, the Bacabs-as-a-class and the Are Ona Kakanfo, and the census says they are the first ADDs if the owner wants office-deities. The imperial line, two thousand years of emperors absent entirely, is deferred AS A UNIT rather than sampled. DISCLOSURES: fifteen of the fifty come from two sixteenth-century novels and every such record says so on its face rather than presenting a Ming invention as ancient myth. Laozi is an ALIAS on Daode Tianzun and not a record, because the tradition treats the philosopher as a descent of the deity and not the reverse; no position is taken on his historicity. Yanluo Wang is linked counterpart-of to buddhist_yama and NOT merged. NO relation is written between Xihe and Houyi despite his shooting nine of her ten children, because the tradition states none and inventing an enmity would be worse than recording the absence. 11 REJECT are classes and offices. 5 CROSS-TRADITION rows cover the Yama transmission, the false Tudigong/baule_asie match (recorded so the 2-of-72 hit rate is not misread), and Chiyou's claim by the Miao and Hmong, of whom the corpus holds ten records. 15 BLOCKED: named-and-not-retrieved (Taiyi Jiuku Tianzun, Houtu, Yuelao, Changxi, Longmu, Huang Feihu and the Fengshen middle cast); reciprocals this batch's own records cannot carry (Di Jun for Xihe, Liu Bei and Zhang Fei for Guan Yu, the other three Dragon Kings, the other eight Kings of Hell); and not-searched-and-named-as-such. CONFUCIUS is the notable block -- he has had state temples for two thousand years and is a cult figure on this registry's own terms, and he is absent only because he was not researched in this session and writing him from recall is what this programme does not do. He is a strong ADD for the next pass. 10 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-11/chinese-census.tsv and chinese-audit.md.

First Japanese pass. 48 -> 95 records. A 61-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 10 hits and 51 absences, six of the ten being deliberate controls and two of the remaining four FALSE POSITIVES: 'Takemikazuchi' matched japanese_kojiki_takemikazuchi_miwa, who is a human scion of the Miwa line and not the thunder kami of Kashima (the new record is given a distinguishing id), and 'Bishamonten'/'Emma' matched buddhist_vaishravana and buddhist_yama, the Indian ends of two transmissions. THE BASELINE OF 48 WAS MISLEADING: roughly twenty of the 48 are a single late-Heian Minamoto genealogy (Yoshiie through Yoritomo and Yoshitsune) and another seven a Kojiki mythohistorical sub-branch around the Miwa line, so the kami pantheon proper was about twenty records. What it was missing was structure rather than ornament. ABSENT: all five Kotoamatsukami, including Ame-no-Minakanushi, who is the first being in the Kojiki and therefore the first sentence of Japanese literature; the whole rock-cave cast except the goddess who hid and the goddess who danced -- no Omoikane whose plan it was, no Ame-no-Tajikarao who opened the door, no Ishikoridome who made the mirror, no Tamanooya who strung the jewels, no Ame-no-Koyane and Futodama who did the divination and are the ancestral deities of the two clans that ran Japanese court ritual for a thousand years; Yamata-no-Orochi and Kushinada-hime and her parents, in a corpus holding Susanoo; BOTH ENVOYS AND BOTH SONS of the kuni-yuzuri, so the transaction the imperial house's legitimacy rests on had one party present; the entire Hyuga cycle between Ninigi and Jimmu, so the descent from Amaterasu broke off two generations short of arriving; Jimmu, Yamato Takeru and Empress Jingu; five of the Seven Lucky Gods; and Tenjin, the most widely worshipped deified human in Japan. 47 ingested via data-sources/transcripts/japanese-expansion.txt. ONE PRE-EXISTING RECORD MODIFIED: japanese_konohanasakuya_hime gains the reciprocal sibling edge to the new Iwanaga-hime, because the two sisters are defined entirely against each other -- blossom and rock -- and the Kojiki's point is that sending the rock back traded the imperial line's immortality for its looks. 13 inserted lines in data-sources/transcripts/a577b80600b7956a8.txt and nothing else touched. DELIBERATE NON-ACTIONS: yokai are not ingested as classes (tengu, kappa, kitsune, oni, tanuki are REJECT rows; the three NAMED yokai -- Shuten-doji, Tamamo-no-Mae, Yamata-no-Orochi -- are records). Ojin is NOT added, because he is deified as Hachiman, whom the registry holds and whose own record derives the name from the eight banners at Ojin's birth; Jingu's mother-of edge points at the Hachiman record. Bishamonten is linked counterpart-of to buddhist_vaishravana and not merged. THE BUDDHIST/JAPANESE KEY SPLIT IS NOT RESOLVED and is escalated: Kannon, Jizo, Amida, Fudo Myoo and Emma are BLOCKED on it, not on evidence. This is the FIFTH LANE RUNNING to raise a tradition-key question (Canaanite, Yoruba, Maya, Chinese, Japanese), which is a pattern rather than five coincidences and argues for a deliberate review. FOUR CONTRADICTIONS CARRIED: the first kami (Ame-no-Minakanushi in the Kojiki, Kuninotokotachi in the Nihon Shoki -- a live political question for a thousand years, and both are records); who killed the food goddess (Susanoo in the Kojiki, Tsukuyomi in the Nihon Shoki, where the murder is why sun and moon are never in the sky together); who exposed Tamamo-no-Mae (Seimei or his successor Yasunari); and Jimmu's historicity (660 BC per the chronicles, no evidence per the historians). 11 REJECT are kinds, categories, places and objects. 13 BLOCKED, of which two are worth escalating: SUKUNABIKONA, one of the best-known figures in the Izumo material, whose neighbours the same search returned and who it did not; and EMPEROR SUTOKU, the third of the three greatest yokai, which this batch therefore holds as two of three -- the exact fault it has spent five traditions objecting to. Both are strong ADDs for a second pass. The Kintaro identification with Sakata no Kintoki is standard in Japan, was not returned by the sources consulted, and is blocked rather than asserted. 4 kinless figures carry cited verified-solitary verdicts. PARTIAL. See audits/lane-12/japanese-census.tsv and japanese-audit.md.

First Norse pass. 67 -> 101 records. A 51-name check across the WHOLE registry returned 11 hits and 40 absences; eight of the eleven were deliberate controls and the other three are FALSE -- 'Sol' matched roman_sol, 'Mani' matched nuer_mani, 'Nerthus' matched continental_germanic_nerthus. THE HEADLINE ABSENCE, and the eighth tradition running to show it: THE REGISTRY HELD SIGURD AND NOT THE DRAGON. No Fafnir.
